name: Intent Router
description: Works out what a customer message wants, so it reaches the right flow. Runs on 0G Compute's TeeML model (0gm-1.0-35b-a3b).

task.instructions: Classify what each customer wants to do.

labels.hint: cancel my order, cancel the order, don't want the order

labels.name: check_balance

labels.name: track_package
labels.hint: where is my package, tracking, parcel, delivery status
